svg.desc: Mistake → program Repeated operational mistakes become executable checks. seen twice move into code 1 wake One event, then sleep GPUs sat idle. Wake lists all work Events, orders, tasks, idle cards. 2 GPUs GPU memory held Computation stayed idle. Watch utilization Idle uses the 10-minute average. 3 jobs Time limit became failure Finished items were discarded. Save and requeue Time limits retain completed items. 4 reports Promises replaced results The update was only a promise. Check message content Refuse promises; require concrete results. 5 models Model silently weakened The chat used another model. Owner chooses each model Each chat uses the selected model. 6 files Reports became cloud-only Linked evidence left local storage. Keep linked files local Board-linked files retain readable bytes.
